spots.name: Jazine za sva vrimena
spots.blurb: You've reached Jazine za sva vrimena, a mural by Inks from 2020. It shows Košarkaški klub Jazine. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
